rationale: %YAML declares the version the document resolves under, and 1.1 and 1.2 genuinely disagree on yes/no/on/off, octal and sexagesimal. It was dropped entirely. Recording it also makes the lane's declared limitation visible instead of silent: the wired grammar is the 1.2 core-schema build, so a file declaring 1.1 is still resolved with 1.2 rules here (design_decision YAML-D6).

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
